_about: Robert Yelverton Tyrrell (1844-1914), Trinity College Dublin: Latin Poetry, lectures delivered in 1893 on the Percy Turnbull Memorial Foundation (Boston and New York: Houghton, Mifflin, 1895): Latin Poetry: lectures delivered in 1893 on the Percy Turnbull Memorial Foundation in the Johns Hopkins University (Boston and New York: Houghton, Mifflin, 1895), raw IA OCR. Added 2026-10-23: Essays on Greek Literature (London: Macmillan, 1909), raw IA OCR. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics). No uids minted. Also raw IA: The Correspondence of M. Tullius Cicero, with L. C. Purser (Dublin: Hodges, Figgis, 7 vols.), the latest edition found for each volume: I (3rd ed. 1904), II (1st ed. 1886), III (1st ed. 1890), IV (2nd ed. 1918), V (2nd ed. 1915), VI (1899), VII index (1901); Latin text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling.
